quote: A vehicle shall not be turned so as to proceed in the opposite direction upon any curve, or upon the approach to or near the crest of a grade, where such vehicle cannot be seen by the driver of any other vehicle approaching from either direction within 500 feet.

activation.condition: vehicle turned to proceed in the opposite direction upon a curve or upon the approach to or near a crest, with visibility evaluated from both approaching directions

obligation.description: do not make that opposite-direction turn when the stated visibility condition holds

timing.description: evaluate the road geometry and visibility at the turn location and time

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: cannot be seen by the driver of any other vehicle approaching from either direction within 500 feet
judgment_calls_needed.note: Driver-eye and target-body visibility must be reviewed for both approach directions; the authored sightline radius is not an observed legal result.

parameter_refs.name: authored_sightline_limit_ft
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: physical sightline geometry setting in feet; not an observed visibility verdict
